audit_subject: SQLite schema v9 effect_outbox reserve-before-effect boundary
substantive_change: Every prepared SQLite ledger entry now receives one reserved effect_outbox row atomically with the ledger insert; signed terminal transitions atomically update the same row to terminal state/result/sequence.
refactor_scope: Centralized SQLite schema/material/effect-state/outbox constants inside sqlite_replay_ledger.cpp; larger file split remains future work.
residual_risk: No production authorization API yet; controls still supply trust roots, policy, clocks, proof secret, and expected outcomes.
No effect worker, claim leases, downstream adapter, attempt backoff, or reconciliation against authoritative downstream state.
Outbox is local SQLite evidence, not distributed exactly-once delivery.
Several older ledger/snapshot/transition signing inputs remain newline-delimited and need explicit migration.
